  | add l r ihL ihR =>
    -- We need to process compile l then compile r then [.plus]
    dsimp only *;
    <;> rw [ihL];
    <;> rfl

inductive Expr where
  | lit : Nat → Expr
  | add : Expr → Expr → Expr
inductive Instr where
  | push : Nat → Instr
  | plus : Instr
def eval : Expr → Nat
  | .lit n => n
  | .add l r => eval l + eval r
def compile : Expr → List Instr
  | .lit n => [.push n]
  | .add l r => compile l ++ compile r ++ [.plus]
def run : List Instr → List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | [], s => some s
  | .push n :: code, s => run code (n :: s)
  | .plus :: code, a :: b :: s => run code ((b + a) :: s)
  | .plus :: _, _ => none

-- Lemma: push on accumulator  
theorem run_push (acc : List Nat) (n : Nat) : run [.push n] acc = some (n :: acc) := by
  unfold run; simp

-- Main theorem  
theorem compiler_correct (e : Expr) : run (compile e) [] = some [eval e] := by
  induction e with
  | lit n =>
    unfold run; simp
  | add l r ihL ihR =>
    dsimp;
    <;> rw [ihL];
    <;> rfl
